questions.prompt: Which statement best describes cloud computing?
options: Storing files on a USB drive
Renting computing resources over the internet on demand and paying for what you use
Buying servers and keeping them in your office
questions.explanation: The NIST definition centers on on-demand, network-accessible, pooled, elastic and metered resources.

questions.prompt: A bakery uses Microsoft 365 for email and documents. Which service model is that?
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 is a complete application delivered over the internet — SaaS. The bakery manages only its data and users.

questions.prompt: In every cloud service model, which of these is ALWAYS the customer's responsibility?
questions.explanation: Shared responsibility: the provider secures the cloud; you always own your information, accounts and who can get in.

questions.prompt: Which characteristic describes scaling up quickly for a holiday rush and back down after?
questions.explanation: Elasticity is growing and shrinking capacity with demand.

questions.prompt: What is the AWS name for what Azure calls Blob Storage?
questions.explanation: S3 (Simple Storage Service) is AWS object storage, equivalent to Azure Blob Storage and Google Cloud Storage.

questions.prompt: Why spread resources across availability zones?
options: So a failure in one datacenter does not take your service down
It is required for every resource
To use a different cloud provider
questions.explanation: Zones are physically separate within a region; spreading across them improves availability.

questions.prompt: What does a cloud budget alert do when you hit 100%?
options: Sends a notification; spending can continue
Moves you to the free tier
questions.explanation: Budgets notify. They are not hard caps. Cleanup and monitoring keep costs under control.

questions.prompt: Which MFA method is MOST resistant to phishing?
questions.explanation: Passkeys and FIDO2 keys are bound to the real website, so a fake login page can't capture a usable credential.

questions.prompt: What is least privilege?
options: Giving each identity only the access it needs, for only as long as it needs it
questions.explanation: Least privilege limits the damage if an account is stolen or misused.

questions.prompt: You created a VM and deleted it, but you are still being charged. What is the most likely cause?
options: Related resources like the disk or public IP were left behind
VMs always charge for 30 days after deletion
questions.explanation: Disks, public IPs and other dependent resources can bill separately. Deleting the whole resource group avoids this in Azure.

questions.prompt: Which is the DCT question you ask about cost?
questions.explanation: The three questions: Who can access it? What could it cost? How will I clean it up?

questions.prompt: What makes a website "static"?
options: Files are delivered exactly as stored, with no server-side code or database
It runs on a virtual machine
questions.explanation: Static sites are pre-built files served as-is.

questions.prompt: In Azure, which container serves the static website files?
questions.explanation: Enabling static website on a storage account creates the special $web container.

questions.prompt: Which redundancy option did the lab use because it is the lowest-cost?
questions.explanation: LRS keeps three copies in one datacenter. Fine for a learning site, not for critical data.

questions.prompt: Why is turning off S3 Block Public Access risky in general?
options: Anything placed in that bucket can become readable by anyone on the internet
questions.explanation: Public buckets are a leading cause of data exposure. Only static public content belongs there.

questions.prompt: A stopped (deallocated) Azure VM still generates charges for which resource?
options: The managed disk (and a static public IP, if any)
questions.explanation: Compute stops billing when deallocated; storage and public IPs do not.

questions.prompt: Why limit the SSH rule to "My IP address"?
options: Bots scan the internet for open SSH ports constantly
SSH only works from one IP
It is required to download the key
questions.explanation: Reducing exposure is basic attack-surface reduction.

questions.prompt: Which file must you keep private?
questions.explanation: Anyone with your private key can log in as you.

questions.prompt: What is the cleanest way to remove everything from Lab 4 in Azure?
questions.explanation: The resource group contains the VM, disk, NIC, IP, NSG and VNet. Deleting it removes them all.

questions.prompt: Which software lets one physical server run many isolated VMs?
questions.explanation: The hypervisor virtualizes CPU, memory, storage and network for each VM.

questions.prompt: Which NIST characteristic describes paying only for what you consume?
questions.explanation: Metered usage is the measured-service characteristic.

questions.prompt: A startup deploys code to Azure App Service and never patches an OS. Which model?
questions.explanation: In PaaS the provider manages the OS and runtime; you deploy code.

questions.prompt: Which is an example of IaaS?
questions.explanation: VMs give you the infrastructure; you manage the OS up.

questions.prompt: Combining an on-premises datacenter with Azure is called:
questions.explanation: Hybrid connects private/on-premises infrastructure with public cloud.

questions.prompt: Using both AWS and Google Cloud at the same company is called:
questions.explanation: Multi-cloud means more than one public provider.

questions.prompt: Moving from buying servers to paying monthly for cloud shifts spending from:
questions.explanation: Cloud converts large up-front capital costs into operating costs.

questions.prompt: What does Google Cloud call the AWS EC2 equivalent?
questions.explanation: Compute Engine provides VMs on Google Cloud.

questions.prompt: What is an availability zone?
options: A physically separate datacenter location within a region
questions.explanation: Zones have independent power, cooling and networking.

questions.prompt: Which identity should you use for everyday cloud work?
options: A separate account with only the roles you need
questions.explanation: Protect the master key; work with least privilege.

questions.prompt: Which is NOT one of the three DCT pre-build questions?
options: How will I clean it up?
questions.explanation: Access, cost, cleanup.

questions.prompt: A storage account's static website endpoint shows "404". What's the first thing to check?
options: Files were uploaded to the $web container with the exact index document name
questions.explanation: Wrong container or filename is the most common cause.

questions.prompt: SSH uses which default port?
questions.explanation: SSH is port 22. RDP (Windows) is 3389.

questions.prompt: Which of these keeps billing after you delete only the VM itself in Azure?
questions.explanation: Disks can be left behind unless deleted with the VM or the resource group.

questions.prompt: What is the safest MFA choice listed?
questions.explanation: Passkeys are phishing-resistant.

questions.prompt: Under shared responsibility, who secures the physical datacenter?
questions.explanation: Physical security is always the provider's.

questions.prompt: Serverless functions are billed mainly by:
options: Executions and the compute time/memory they use
questions.explanation: Functions charge per execution and resource consumption, often with a free monthly grant.

questions.prompt: Which Azure feature groups related resources so they can be managed and deleted together?
questions.explanation: Resource groups are the lifecycle container in Azure.

questions.prompt: What should a public storage bucket contain?
options: Only content you intend everyone on the internet to read
questions.explanation: Public means public. Everything else stays private.

questions.prompt: Your budget alert fires at 80%. What does it do?
questions.explanation: Alerts notify; you act.

questions.prompt: Which DCT learning sequence does every course follow?
questions.explanation: Understand, Use, Protect, Create — every program, every module.
